text_block_list.text: While walking around the academy, I spotted Biwa Hayahide and Air Groove talking.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: In other words, Brian is absent from the student council again... I apologize for the inconvenience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm already used to it.
Including the President being out of the office.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even so, today's meeting is urgent.
We cannot postpone it, even if we're a bit short-staffed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I will help out again this time
in place of Brian."
choice_data_list: Are you going to help out the student council?
Are you helping out the student council?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, you guessed right. Sorry, but
today's training might start a bit late."

Since I had the opportunity, I decided to observe
the meeting Biwa Hayahide was helping with.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
First, regarding today's agenda.
Sharing it on screen—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm, where's the data?
Who updated it last...?

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, that was probably me...!
I'm pretty sure the data is over here—huh, wait!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, if it's going to take too long, never mind.
Just give me a verbal explanation—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
“—No problem. I have the relevant data ready.
I'll project it right away.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Are you serious? That's a huge help.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What is this graph?
I don't recall creating this—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I prepared it just a moment ago.
I figured this would be easier to understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――Now then, it seems all opinions have been voiced.
Before we proceed to a vote, I will take any questions.

text_block_list.name: Laid-Back Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, could you tell me what you were just saying
one more time? If I remember right... um, about the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That question is far too vague...
At least tell me whose opinion it was.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's recorded in the meeting minutes.
That was the opinion of the third speaker.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Here are the details: 'A proposal to increase the stock of daily necessities in dormitory facilities to accommodate the growing student body.'
That's it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The meeting wrapped up smoothly.
Good work, Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Hayahide, won't you join the student council?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I've been trying to recruit you for a while now, but today I'm certain!
With you around, so many of our problems will be solved...!!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I agree with Air Groove. I was watching partway through,
and you did a wonderful job.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With all due respect... I am not quite that versatile.
I don't believe I can balance that with racing.
Trainer, don't you agree?
choice_data_list: Why not try it for just a day?
What if you joined on the condition that they look after your little sister?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Just for one day, huh?
...Well, if it's only that long...

And so, Biwa Hayahide agreed to help with the
student council's work for just one day. However—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The pool's temperature setting, huh... Come to think of it, why is it set to the current temperature? Is there a reason for it?
All right, let's look through past records—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A battle over the school store's bread, huh. Increasing inventory
seems like it'd solve the problem, but... is there some reason they can't?
Alright, let's look into it—

Perhaps due to her tendency to push herself too hard,
once she started, there was no sign of her work coming to an end...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay, Biwa Hayahide? It's already night.
I think you're pushing yourself a bit too hard...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—Night already!? I'm so sorry, I completely lost track of time...!
Given my personality, perhaps I'm really just not cut out
for this after all...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, pushing too hard defeats the purpose.
Let us return to the drawing board on this matter for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A valuable asset has been—
Damn, so close...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I see... That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If left alone, Brian will push herself too hard right away.
And I can't watch over her all by myself. But
if I have the Student Council's help—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...No, that's impossible.
Even we can't fully keep tabs on their actions."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I agree. I try to follow along as best I can,
but it's difficult to grasp everything completely.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...
In that case, please pretend we never had this conversation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, Hayahide, you're welcome anytime you feel like it!
Literally, anytime!
